Signer:   POLYBIUS Operator Pool <pool@polybius.local>

This document lists the ten procedurally assigned Admin/user accounts
bootstrapped into the matching Android arm64 APK on first install.
Passwords are alphanumeric, ≤12 characters, and chosen to be memorable.
Each operator has a unique invite code for the hidden crypto-engine portal.

VERIFY this file's cleartext signature with:
  gpg --verify ADMIN_USER_POOL.txt.asc
Import the accompanying public key first:
  gpg --import polybius-pool-pubkey.asc

DOWNLOAD
--------
https://github.com/RedTeamFortress666/Main/raw/cursor/polybius-flutter-app-a932/polybius/dist/polybius-1.0.0-beta.1-admin-user-arm64.apk

HOW TO ENTER THE CRYPTO ENGINE
------------------------------
1. Install the APK and launch PØLYBĪUS.
2. Ritual: hold title 6s → SETTINGS → difficulty 11 (blank after 10)
   → LANGUAGES → Russian → hold SELECT 3s.
3. At the portal enter: login · password (or backup) · invite code.
4. Enter the 6-digit PIN when prompted.

Admin-tier operators receive full engine access with their invite code.
Agent-tier operators receive cipher (user) access.
